name: vaipakam-mesh-watcher
description: Internal-only Cloudflare Worker that watches the VPFI recycling mesh (#1222 M3 B4-c). Reads every reward chain's recycled ledger — Base's per-chain books plus each mirror's own bucket and reservation counters — and alerts on accounting invariants that cannot legitimately break. Ops-internal Telegram bot, separate D1, distinct from the user-facing keeper/agent surfaces.
